truthRule: A system-level PASS requires current repository inventory, explicit product/core ownership, security fleet evidence, Steward evidence, operational simplicity criteria and DoneCheck/Human Threshold closure.

Earlier adil-pay-kanit-web repository record is retained as evidence; canonical product ownership will be assigned at production start.

architecture.criterion: Canonical control plane + bounded product execution planes + reusable shared governance.

governanceEvidence.criterion: State → claim → evidence → next action; DoneCheck and Human Threshold retained.

productCoreSeparation.criterion: Every active asset has exactly one canonical owner/type; transitional control-plane copies reduce to adapters when evidence permits.

repositoryOrder.criterion: Current inventory equals accessible repository truth; planned products are explicit and do not distort active repository truth.

security.criterion: All governed repos adopt pinned IP & Model Trust Fleet and produce green evidence; real secret findings remain fail-closed.

automationSteward.criterion: Steward inventories, detects drift, proposes safe metadata fixes, and requires Human Threshold for destructive/high-impact actions.

operationalSimplicity.criterion: A human can answer Products / Cores / Runtime / Evidence / State from one canonical surface without traversing duplicate governance layers.
